newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING - Supermercados Unimarc S.A.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING - Supermercados Unimarc S.A.

text.p: Supermercados Unimarc S.A. filed Wednesday an initial public offering with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 4,460,000 American Depositary Shares.

Supermercados, known in English as Unimarc Supermarkets Inc, said the ADS represent 223,000,000 common shares. The offering has an aggregate value of $88,308,000. The ADS are estimated to be priced at between $16 and $18 per share.
Of the total, 2,148,000 ADS are being offered in the United States and Canada by U.S. underwriters and 1,431,000 ADS are being offered outside the U.S., Canada and Chile.
Concurrently with the ADS offering, 44,050,000 common shares are being offered for sale in Chile by Chilean underwriters.
The company has granted underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to buy up to 446,000 additional ADS. The offering will be made through Salomon Brothers Inc and Paribas.
Net proceeds willl be used to fund a portion of the company's expansion and renovation program.
Supermercados, based in Santiago, is the third largest operator of supermarkets in Chile and the second largest in the capital city in terms of sales.
